integrity: The result is derived analytically; finite graph and quadrature calculations supplement but do not replace proof. Independent verification has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact result concerns distinct adjacency spectral values and an infinite-time Euclidean chord average; it does not address finite-time QAOA performance, quantum-walk mixing, or all square-order resonance profiles. The full primary manuscript was unavailable for comparison, so publication-priority risk remains.
title: Arithmetic resonance of long-time unitary chord gaps on Paley graphs
